correctness.rationale: The reciprocal-divisor equivalence and all parity, size, and prime-factor cases were rederived. The only bounded residue, 4|n<=48, was checked exactly; a separate exact scan through 10^6 also found zero hits.

originality.rationale: The original F-perfect source, the full 2025 near-F_k-perfect paper, its 2023 precursor, exact and synonymous current-status searches, and the SCOPE archive were checked. No equivalent global nonexistence theorem was located; originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the entire near F-perfect ([2,3]-near-perfect) existence problem and replaces prior factorization-specific exclusions by a short general reciprocal-divisor obstruction.
